name: Tiger Mastery
summary: At Nesingwary's Expedition, Ajeck Rouack trains hunters to track big cats. She begins with young tigers near the northern camp, testing a newcomer's hunting and tracking skills.

sections.title: First Lessons in the Jungle
sections.body: Ajeck Rouack learned to hunt tigers from her father when she was a girl. Now she shares his craft with travelers who reach Nesingwary's Expedition after Welcome to the Jungle. Young tigers are the first quarry. Tracking and hunting them prepare you to pursue greater prey.

sections.title: Hunting the Prowlers
sections.body: Young Stranglethorn tigers prowl the jungle near the expedition camp. Ajeck Rouack asks you to hunt ten. She wants proof of your skill before she offers further training.

faq.q: Who offers to train you in tiger hunting?
faq.answer: Ajeck Rouack offers to train you in tiger hunting at Nesingwary's Expedition in northern Stranglethorn Vale.

faq.q: Why does Ajeck Rouack target young tigers first?
faq.answer: Ajeck Rouack begins with young tigers because she considers them easier to track and hunt. They test your tracking skills before you pursue more dangerous quarry.

faq.q: Where are the young tigers found?
faq.answer: Young Stranglethorn tigers prowl the jungle near Nesingwary's Expedition camp.
You arrive at the safari camp after Welcome to the Jungle, which introduces you to the camp.
